scientific_integrity: The theorem establishes new statements for a specified, previously derived large-population stationary probability measure. It does not establish a microscopic limit theorem or independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Requires the stationary large-population attractive rank-diffusion law of arXiv:2308.06118v1 as input.
No claim for finite populations, thermal noise, external trapping, dynamics, or uniform rates.
Prior general stationary-moment integral permits derivation of individual moments. A previously unindexed equivalent monotonicity theorem remains a residual originality risk.
title: Universal even-moment ordering and a unique kurtosis threshold in active rank diffusion
